Name: JP's Farms - Standard Little Farm - Small Farm
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#ff7700][u][center]Little Standard farm[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]It's not bad to have a little less space on the farm, so you will have to manage your space better, like in survival horror games. It will be a challenge or the beginning of your big dreams.[/b][/size][/color]



[b][i][color=#00ffff][size=6][u]Map Features:[/u][/size]
[/color][/i][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]The map is half the size of the normal farm.[/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b]Several buildings were relocated to maximize the use of space.[/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b]The ponds were removed and a new one was placed behind the house.[/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b]Removed some obstacles that prevented the cultivation/placement of buildings.[/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b]Added two rice ponds to the left side of the farm (Optional, configurable). [i][color=#ff0000]I have no idea if ducks can swim there.[/color][/i][/b][/size]
[/list][size=3][b]

[/b][/size][b][i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Installation:
[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]
[/font][b][font=Georgia][size=3]Download the mod, unzip it in the Mods folder of the game. Configure it with the mod [/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. Check new mod requirements.
